purpose: Case-set registry: the purpose, upstream partition, size, draw seed and eligibility of every case set, fixed before anything is drawn. Read by ehr_evidence_app.casesets.registry, which refuses to run unless these values equal the ones it implements.
draw_rule: Eligible cases are ranked by the SHA-256 of the text '<label>:<seed>:<patient_index>' and the first <size> are taken; case numbers follow ascending patient_index. Cases that later fail admission are reported, never replaced.
eligibility: the graph lies in the named upstream partition, by the split replay verified against the run-binding record
the graph carries y_diagnosis (the bridge filter)
the graph has a readable subject_id and at least min_visit_nodes visit nodes, each with a readable visit identifier
the case does not belong to an excluded case set

dev-30-v1.statement: Development case set: an engineering sample for building and tuning the application. It is not an evaluation cohort and not a clinical quality target.

eval-100-v1.statement: Evaluation case set: drawn once from the upstream test partition and held for the final evaluation; never used for development or tuning. It is not a clinical quality target.
